nodes.text: @StanFinger @outbreakupdates @morgfair it’s just hMPV in China, reporting is overhyped, it’s winter; colds, flus etc. ~150 million cases of hMPV /yr is normal. Hospital crowds is normal for winter and u’ll notice many on drips, that’s just cultural … perceived as more effective than pills and get time off work 😏
